issues.description: play.ts ships a debugging scratchpad with relative imports and console.logs
issues.detail: play.ts was rewritten from a clean import test into author scratch with `import * as z from "./packages/zod/src/index.js"` and console.log debug cases. This is local scribble, not shippable artifact. Drop it from the PR or convert the cases into named tests under tests/.

issues.description: Override semantics silently changed; overrideCount jumped 6 to 12 with no justification
issues.detail: The old `if (!seen.isParent) override(...)` guard was removed, so override now fires on every flattenRef pass. The test named `do not run on references` was updated from 6 to 12 to pass — that name is now a lie. Either restore the guard or document the new contract in code, commit message, and changelog.

issues.description: Quadratic JSON.stringify dedup in nested key loops is wrong data structure and asymptotically bad
issues.detail: finalize() walks `for (const key in schema)` calling `JSON.stringify(schema[key]) === JSON.stringify(refSeen.def![key])` in two places per seen schema. This is O(N*size), key-order sensitive (false negatives on same object with different insertion order), and pathological on deep trees. Replace with structural deep-equal or identity comparison, or fingerprint the def once.

issues.description: Recursive flattenRef re-enters via seen.parent without a clear termination guard
issues.detail: flattenRef nulls `seen.ref` as its recursion sentinel but also recurses on `seen.parent`, which has no equivalent guard. Termination relies on parent chains being acyclic — an invariant the type system doesn't enforce. Add an explicit visited set or document why parent chains are guaranteed acyclic.

issues.description: Seen carries overlapping ref/parent fields whose precedence lives in comments, not types
issues.detail: Seen gained `parent` alongside `ref`, and finalize() juggles three cases: ref===parent, ref!==parent, ref===null sentinel. The data shape no longer makes the algorithm obvious and no loop invariant is stated. Either collapse to one field with explicit kind, or state the invariant at the type and in a literate comment over flattenRef.

issues.description: Commit bundles three independent changes that should be separate patches
issues.detail: The diff combines (a) parent/ref tracking rework in to-json-schema, (b) fileProcessor anyOf hoisting (a user-visible JSON Schema output change), and (c) the mini ZodType `{parent: true}` flip. Each is independently reviewable and revertable. Split into three patches so regressions can be bisected and the override-semantics change can be evaluated on its own.

synthesis.summary: NEEDS-WORK. The core idea — separating `parent` (clone-chain ancestor) from `ref` (processor-supplied inheritance) so $ref propagates through wrappers like `readonly().meta({id}).describe()` — is sound, and the fileProcessor anyOf factoring is a clean small win. But the patch is the wrong shape to land: it ships a debugging scratchpad (play.ts), silently doubles override callback invocations against a test literally named "do not run on references", and introduces JSON.stringify-based dedup loops that are both asymptotically bad and semantically fragile to key ordering. The new Seen shape with overlapping ref/parent fields and a flattenRef recursion that re-enters via seen.parent without a guard need either a stated invariant or a tighter data model. Drop play.ts, justify or revert the override-count change, replace stringify dedup with structural comparison, and document the recursion termination — then it can land.
